entities.name: Dedicated core network rejection
entities.description: Network rejection of mobility management signalling requests from UEs due to dedicated core network restrictions as specified in 3GPP TS 23.401.

entities.name: Mobility management signalling request
entities.description: Mobility management signalling requests initiated by UEs that may be rejected due to dedicated core network restrictions.

entities.name: NAS level mobility management congestion control
entities.description: General NAS level mobility management congestion control mechanism specified in clause 5.3.9 that must be followed when network rejects requests due to dedicated core network.

relations.description: Dedicated core network rejection condition applies to mobility management signalling requests from UEs.
When network rejects mobility management signalling requests due to dedicated core network, the NAS level mobility management congestion control procedure must be followed.
